//go:build integration

package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"reflect"
	"regexp"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	courseclient "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/infrastructure/http/courseclient"
	natsadapter "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/infrastructure/messaging/nats"
	publichttp "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/api/v1"
	publichandlers "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/api/v1/handlers"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/middleware"
	privatehttp "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/private"
	privatehandlers "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
	outboxuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/outbox"
	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
	natsgo "github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
)

// Root owns infrastructure setup and launch. This provider composes registered
// diagnostic HTTP, actual Course clients, scorer/usecase and PostgreSQL, plus
// the production relay/publisher. It never reserves or completes an attempt
// itself. The synthetic onboarding identity is the only learner fixture.
func TestT18ServeDiagnosticStudentHTTP(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("T18_SERVE_STUDENT") != "true" {
		t.Skip("owned T18 Student provider gate absent")
	}
	ready, stop, result := os.Getenv("T18_STUDENT_READY_FILE"), os.Getenv("T18_STUDENT_STOP_FILE"), os.Getenv("T18_STUDENT_RESULT_FILE")
	token, plannerToken := os.Getenv("T18_STUDENT_TOKEN"), os.Getenv("T18_STUDENT_PLANNER_TOKEN")
	cfg, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(os.Getenv("STUDENT_TEST_DATABASE_URL"))
	host := os.Getenv("T18_ATTESTED_POSTGRES_HOST")
	if err != nil || (!t18AcceptanceDatabase(t, cfg, "student") && (cfg.ConnConfig.Database != "remediation_t18_student_integration_proof" || os.Getenv("T18_OWNED_STUDENT_DATABASE_NAME") != cfg.ConnConfig.Database || host == "" || net.ParseIP(host) == nil || cfg.ConnConfig.Host != host)) || token == "" || plannerToken == "" || token == plannerToken || ready == "" || stop == "" || result == "" {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: exact owned Student configuration required")
	}
	for _, path := range []string{ready, stop, result} {
		if _, err := os.Lstat(path); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
			t.Fatal("SETUP: metadata and stop paths must be absent")
		}
	}
	var course struct {
		URL                string `json:"url"`
		CourseID           string `json:"course_id"`
		CurriculumRevision string `json:"curriculum_revision"`
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(os.Getenv("T18_COURSE_READY_FILE"))
	if err != nil || json.Unmarshal(raw, &course) != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: owned Course metadata unavailable")
	}
	courseURL, err := url.Parse(course.URL)
	if err != nil || courseURL.Scheme != "http" || courseURL.Hostname() != "127.0.0.1" || courseURL.User != nil || courseURL.Path != "" || os.Getenv("T18_COURSE_TOKEN") == "" || os.Getenv("T18_COURSE_CATALOG_TOKEN") == "" || os.Getenv("T18_COURSE_TOKEN") == os.Getenv("T18_COURSE_CATALOG_TOKEN") {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: owned loopback Course required")
	}
	natsURL, err := url.Parse(os.Getenv("T18_NATS_URL"))
	if err != nil || (!t18AcceptanceNATS(t, os.Getenv("T18_NATS_URL")) && (natsURL.Scheme != "nats" || natsURL.Hostname() != "127.0.0.1" || natsURL.User != nil)) {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: dedicated loopback NATS required")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	pool, err := pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, cfg)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: Student pool unavailable")
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	var database string
	if pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT current_database()`).Scan(&database) != nil || database != cfg.ConnConfig.Database {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: exact Student database unavailable")
	}
	t18AcceptanceDatabaseIdentity(t, ctx, pool)
	nc, err := natsgo.Connect(natsURL.String(), natsgo.Timeout(5*time.Second), natsgo.MaxReconnects(-1))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: dedicated NATS unavailable")
	}
	defer nc.Close()
	js, err := nc.JetStream()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: JetStream unavailable")
	}
	stream, err := js.StreamInfo("STUDENT_DIAGNOSTIC_EVENTS", natsgo.Context(ctx))
	if err != nil || len(stream.Config.Subjects) != 1 || stream.Config.Subjects[0] != "student.diagnostic-result.committed.v1" || stream.Config.Retention != natsgo.WorkQueuePolicy {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: dedicated diagnostic stream unavailable")
	}
	clock := t18StudentProviderClock{}
	owner := uuid.NewString()
	profiles := &StudentOnboardingRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	profile, err := (studentuc.PutStudentOnboarding{Profiles: profiles, Clock: clock}).Handle(ctx, studentuc.PutStudentOnboardingInput{StudentID: owner, DirectionCode: "backend", SelfAssessedExperience: "beginner", KnownStacks: []string{}, DesiredStacks: []string{"go"}, GoalCode: "learn_programming", PreferredLanguage: "ru", WeeklyMinutes: 120, PreferredPace: "steady"})
	if err != nil || profile.Version != 1 {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: actual onboarding fixture failed")
	}
	// Facts are deliberately retained. Root disposes only its dedicated database.
	httpClient := &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second, Transport: &http.Transport{Proxy: nil}}
	catalog := courseclient.DiagnosticCatalogClient{BaseURL: course.URL, InternalToken: os.Getenv("T18_COURSE_CATALOG_TOKEN"), HTTPClient: httpClient}
	observed, err := catalog.GetDiagnosticAssessmentCatalog(ctx, course.CourseID)
	if err != nil || observed.CurriculumRevision != course.CurriculumRevision || len(observed.Items) != 3 {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: actual Course diagnostic catalog mismatch")
	}
	taskClient := courseclient.Client{BaseURL: course.URL, InternalToken: os.Getenv("T18_COURSE_TOKEN"), HTTPClient: httpClient}
	// Verify the complete production trusted-task read, including its registered
	// Course lesson fallback for course identity, before advertising readiness.
	// This reads definitions only and never scores or submits an answer.
	for _, item := range observed.Items {
		task, err := taskClient.GetDiagnosticTask(ctx, item.TaskID)
		if err != nil || task == nil || task.ID != item.TaskID || task.CourseID != course.CourseID || task.LessonID != item.LessonID || task.Version != item.TaskVersion || !task.UpdatedAt.Equal(item.UpdatedAt) || task.EvaluationMode != "AUTO" || task.AssessmentPurpose != "diagnostic" || task.Type != item.Type || !reflect.DeepEqual(task.LearningTargets, item.LearningTargets) || len(task.Tests) == 0 {
			t.Fatal("SETUP: production Course diagnostic task preflight failed")
		}
	}
	assessments := studentuc.DiagnosticAssessments{Attempts: &DiagnosticAssessmentRepoPG{Pool: pool}, Catalog: catalog, Tasks: taskClient, Clock: clock}
	publisher := &t18StudentPublishCut{Publisher: &natsadapter.OutboxPublisher{Conn: nc}, StudentID: owner}
	relay := outboxuc.Relay{Outbox: &OutboxRepoPG{Pool: pool}, Publisher: publisher, Clock: clock, WorkerID: "t18-" + uuid.NewString(), BatchSize: 10, LockTTL: time.Minute, PublishTimeout: 3 * time.Second, RetryBaseDelay: time.Second, RetryMaxDelay: 5 * time.Second}
	if relay.Validate() != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: actual relay configuration invalid")
	}
	registered := chi.NewRouter()
	learnerOverview := studentuc.GetLearnerOverview{Profiles: profiles, Mastery: &LearningEvidenceRepoPG{Pool: pool}, Journey: &LearningJourneyRepoPG{Pool: pool}}
	registered.Mount("/internal", privatehttp.NewRouter(&privatehandlers.Handler{DiagnosticAssessments: &assessments, OnboardingProfiles: studentuc.GetStudentOnboarding{Profiles: profiles}, PlanningReadiness: studentuc.GetStudentPlanningReadiness{Reader: profiles}, LearnerOverview: learnerOverview}, token, plannerToken))
	registered.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
		r.Use((middleware.AuthMiddleware{}).Middleware)
		r.Route("/api/v1", func(api chi.Router) {
			api.Use(middleware.RequireRole("STUDENT", "STUDENT_PRO"))
			publichttp.RegisterDiagnosticAssessmentRoutes(api, &publichandlers.DiagnosticAssessmentHandler{Assessments: assessments})
		})
	})
	var mu sync.Mutex
	outage := false
	state := func(readCtx context.Context) (map[string]any, error) {
		v := map[string]any{"student_id": owner, "course_id": course.CourseID, "onboarding_version": profile.Version, "goal_code": profile.GoalCode, "direction_code": profile.DirectionCode, "classification": "actual registered Student diagnostic HTTP/usecase/supported quiz scorer/PG and production outbox relay+JetStream publisher; synthetic onboarding; curated Course fixture"}
		for _, item := range []struct{ name, query string }{
			{"attempts", `SELECT count(*) FROM student_diagnostic_assessment_attempt WHERE student_id=$1`},
			{"results", `SELECT count(*) FROM student_diagnostic_assessment_result WHERE student_id=$1`},
			{"submissions", `SELECT count(*) FROM student_diagnostic_assessment_submission s JOIN student_diagnostic_assessment_attempt a ON a.id=s.attempt_id WHERE a.student_id=$1`},
			{"outbox", `SELECT count(*) FROM student_outbox WHERE student_id=$1 AND subject='student.diagnostic-result.committed.v1'`},
			{"published", `SELECT count(*) FROM student_outbox WHERE student_id=$1 AND subject='student.diagnostic-result.committed.v1' AND published_at IS NOT NULL`},
			{"learning_actions", `SELECT count(*) FROM student_learning_action WHERE student_id=$1`},
			{"learning_evidence", `SELECT count(*) FROM student_learning_evidence WHERE student_id=$1`},
			{"target_mastery", `SELECT count(*) FROM student_target_mastery WHERE student_id=$1`},
			{"learning_paths", `SELECT count(*) FROM student_learning_path WHERE student_id=$1`},
			{"course_assignments", `SELECT count(*) FROM student_course_assignment WHERE student_id=$1`},
			{"lesson_facts", `SELECT count(*) FROM student_lesson_activity_fact WHERE student_id=$1`},
		} {
			var count int64
			if err := pool.QueryRow(readCtx, item.query, owner).Scan(&count); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			v[item.name] = count
		}
		v["actual_cut_used"] = publisher.Used()
		return v, nil
	}
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	protected := func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) bool {
		if r.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != token {
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusUnauthorized)
			return false
		}
		return true
	}
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /__t18/state", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if !protected(w, r) {
			return
		}
		readCtx, finish := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 5*time.Second)
		defer finish()
		v, err := state(readCtx)
		if err != nil {
			http.Error(w, "state unavailable", 500)
			return
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(v)
	})
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /__t18/relay", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if !protected(w, r) {
			return
		}
		mu.Lock()
		defer mu.Unlock()
		deliveryCtx, finish := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 35*time.Second)
		defer finish()
		count, err := relay.ProcessBatch(deliveryCtx)
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		if err != nil {
			w.WriteHeader(503)
		}
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"claimed": count, "delivery_succeeded": err == nil})
	})
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /__t18/publish-cut", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if !protected(w, r) {
			return
		}
		var v struct {
			Enabled *bool `json:"enabled"`
		}
		d := json.NewDecoder(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 128))
		d.DisallowUnknownFields()
		if d.Decode(&v) != nil || v.Enabled == nil || d.Decode(&struct{}{}) != io.EOF {
			w.WriteHeader(400)
			return
		}
		if !publisher.Arm(*v.Enabled) {
			w.WriteHeader(409)
			return
		}
		w.WriteHeader(204)
	})
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /__t18/outage", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if !protected(w, r) {
			return
		}
		var v struct {
			Enabled bool `json:"enabled"`
		}
		d := json.NewDecoder(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 128))
		d.DisallowUnknownFields()
		if d.Decode(&v) != nil {
			w.WriteHeader(400)
			return
		}
		mu.Lock()
		outage = v.Enabled
		mu.Unlock()
		w.WriteHeader(204)
	})
	mux.Handle("/", http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		mu.Lock()
		down := outage
		mu.Unlock()
		if down {
			w.WriteHeader(503)
			return
		}
		registered.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	}))
	server := httptest.NewUnstartedServer(mux)
	server.Config.ReadHeaderTimeout = 5 * time.Second
	server.Config.ReadTimeout = 40 * time.Second
	server.Config.WriteTimeout = 40 * time.Second
	server.Config.IdleTimeout = 5 * time.Second
	server.Start()
	defer server.Close()
	defer server.CloseClientConnections()
	metadata, err := state(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: initial state unavailable")
	}
	metadata["url"] = server.URL
	metadata["desired_stacks"] = profile.DesiredStacks
	metadata["preferred_language"] = profile.PreferredLanguage
	t18StudentWriteExclusive(t, ready, metadata)
	ticker := time.NewTicker(100 * time.Millisecond)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			t.Fatal("owned Student 20-minute deadline exceeded")
		case <-ticker.C:
			if _, err := os.Stat(stop); err == nil {
				v, err := state(ctx)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal("owned Student final state unavailable")
				}
				v["url"] = server.URL
				t18StudentWriteExclusive(t, result, v)
				return
			} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
				t.Fatal("owned Student stop read failed")
			}
		}
	}
}
func t18StudentWriteExclusive(t *testing.T, path string, value any) {
	t.Helper()
	raw, err := json.MarshalIndent(value, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("safe Student metadata encoding failed")
	}
	file, err := os.OpenFile(path+".tmp", os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY, 0600)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("exclusive Student metadata creation failed")
	}
	_, writeErr := file.Write(append(raw, '\n'))
	closeErr := file.Close()
	if writeErr != nil || closeErr != nil {
		t.Fatal("safe Student metadata export failed")
	}
	if os.Link(path+".tmp", path) != nil || os.Remove(path+".tmp") != nil {
		t.Fatal("exclusive atomic metadata publication failed")
	}
}

type t18StudentProviderClock struct{}

func (t18StudentProviderClock) Now() time.Time { return time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond) }

// The only injected failure is after the production publisher has obtained a
// real JetStream PubACK. Returning this test sentinel makes the real relay
// persist its failure/retry rather than MarkPublished; neither the event wire
// nor the message ID changes. Each arm can be consumed once, and only by this
// provider's own diagnostic event. Failed broker publishes do not consume it.
var t18StudentPublishCutError = errors.New("T18 test cut after acknowledged actual publish")

type t18StudentPublishCut struct {
	Publisher domain.DurableEventPublisher
	StudentID string
	mu        sync.Mutex
	enabled   bool
	used      int
}

func (publisher *t18StudentPublishCut) Publish(ctx context.Context, event domain.IntegrationEvent) error {
	if err := publisher.Publisher.Publish(ctx, event); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	publisher.mu.Lock()
	defer publisher.mu.Unlock()
	if publisher.enabled && event.StudentID == publisher.StudentID && event.Subject == "student.diagnostic-result.committed.v1" {
		publisher.enabled = false
		publisher.used++
		return t18StudentPublishCutError
	}
	return nil
}
func (publisher *t18StudentPublishCut) Arm(enabled bool) bool {
	publisher.mu.Lock()
	defer publisher.mu.Unlock()
	if enabled && publisher.enabled {
		return false
	}
	publisher.enabled = enabled
	return true
}
func (publisher *t18StudentPublishCut) Used() int {
	publisher.mu.Lock()
	defer publisher.mu.Unlock()
	return publisher.used
}

// t18AcceptanceDatabase permits only the coordinator's explicit isolated fixture.
// Frozen historical fixture defaults remain available when this gate is absent.
func t18AcceptanceDatabase(t *testing.T, cfg *pgxpool.Config, owner string) bool {
	t.Helper()
	if os.Getenv("INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_ISOLATED_FIXTURE") != "true" {
		return false
	}
	if !t18AcceptanceDatabaseMatches(cfg, owner) {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: explicitly attested isolated acceptance database required")
	}
	return true
}

func t18AcceptanceDatabaseMatches(cfg *pgxpool.Config, owner string) bool {
	port, err := strconv.Atoi(os.Getenv("INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_POSTGRES_PORT"))
	name := os.Getenv("INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_" + strings.ToUpper(owner) + "_DATABASE_NAME")
	host := os.Getenv("INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_POSTGRES_HOST")
	backend := os.Getenv("INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_POSTGRES_SERVER_IP")
	return !(cfg == nil || err != nil || port < 1 || port > 65535 || host != "127.0.0.1" || net.ParseIP(backend) == nil || !regexp.MustCompile("^infra_acceptance_"+owner+"_[a-z0-9_]+_test$").MatchString(name) || cfg.ConnConfig.Host != host || int(cfg.ConnConfig.Port) != port || cfg.ConnConfig.Database != name || cfg.ConnConfig.User == "" || cfg.ConnConfig.TLSConfig != nil || len(cfg.ConnConfig.Fallbacks) != 0)
}

func t18AcceptanceDatabaseIdentity(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) {
	t.Helper()
	if os.Getenv("INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_ISOLATED_FIXTURE") != "true" {
		return
	}
	var database, backend string
	if pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT current_database(), host(inet_server_addr())`).Scan(&database, &backend) != nil || database != pool.Config().ConnConfig.Database || backend != os.Getenv("INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_POSTGRES_SERVER_IP") {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: isolated acceptance PostgreSQL backend attestation failed")
	}
}

func t18AcceptanceNATS(t *testing.T, address string) bool {
	t.Helper()
	if os.Getenv("INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_ISOLATED_FIXTURE") != "true" {
		return false
	}
	port, err := strconv.Atoi(os.Getenv("INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_NATS_PORT"))
	broker, parseErr := url.Parse(address)
	if err != nil || port < 1 || port > 65535 || parseErr != nil || broker.Scheme != "nats" || broker.Host != "127.0.0.1:"+strconv.Itoa(port) || broker.User != nil || broker.Path != "" || broker.RawQuery != "" || broker.Fragment != "" {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: explicitly attested isolated acceptance broker required")
	}
	return true
}
